name: CROSS FIRE
source:
Kai lives a peaceful life at St. Lilium High School. But his life starts to collapse after a girl, Rena, transfers to his school. Murder cases, ugly rumors and hostile eyes.... Rena, who's got red eyes, says to Kai, "I'll save you. It's my mission." And the situation starts to involve people around Kai....
